==About==

Crafting a {{i|Sauce Chasseur}} will make an {{i|Unbaked Sauce Chasseur}} which can then be baked in {{i|Any Stove}} for 1 hour to produce a Sauce Chasseur. '''NOTE:''' Remember to boil your Mushrooms to reduce {{i|'Shroom Poisoning}}.
